scope: Independent mechanism/impact adjudication of the fresh cr2/cs2 calibration pair. No scored run had started at review time.

gateEvidence.revisedGate: calibration-gate.json reports every behavioral check true.
gateEvidence.discovery: Both arms discovered exactly the four gold execution coordinates (recall and precision 1.0).
gateEvidence.handoff: cs2 made one successful handoff: four JSONL inputs, four outputs, zero loss, and preserved payload order. Outputs were two ordinary skip:true, one violation, and one unmatched/no-execution-match.
gateEvidence.completion: Both runs finished with a one-for-one disposition Counter for their four discovered candidates and no tool errors.

dangerFindings.sourceEvidence: raw/operations.ts lines 23-29 types phrase as UntrustedInput, concatenates it between SQL string fragments at line 27, then passes the resulting statement to db.query at line 29.
dangerFindings.mechanismAdjudication: pass: the finding accurately identifies untrusted input reaching SQL syntax through string concatenation and correctly links construction to execution.
dangerFindings.impactAdjudication: pass with normal driver-scope limit: a request-controlled phrase can terminate or reshape the ILIKE string literal and alter the executed query. Whether a particular driver permits additional statements is not established by this fixture, but predicate/syntax injection is established.

dangerFindings.sourceEvidence: serene/operations.ts lines 25-31 use the same UntrustedInput concatenation at line 29 and execute the resulting statement at line 31.
dangerFindings.mechanismAdjudication: pass: the finding accurately identifies direct concatenation inside the quoted ILIKE pattern and explains quote/syntax escape into the executed SQL text.
dangerFindings.impactAdjudication: pass with normal driver-scope limit: a request-controlled phrase can alter the statement executed by db.query. The claim about additional SQL is conditional on driver behavior; the demonstrated injection effect is sufficient for this construction review.

skipAndUnmatched.ordinaryNoReread: pass: after cs2 handoff, the only source read was operations.ts:34-40 for sendCalibrationSnapshot. No source line in listActive (5-13) or markComplete (15-23) was delivered after handoff; both dispositions are skip-ordinary.
skipAndUnmatched.ordinaryDiscoveryExposure: reported, not hidden: cs2 read the complete operations.ts body during Discovery, so both ordinary bodies were seen before handoff. The scorer records two actual skips because there was no later exposure.
skipAndUnmatched.unmatched: pass: cs2 retained sendCalibrationSnapshot as ordinal 4 with classification unmatched and reason no-execution-match, targeted-read its complete function after handoff, and supplied a non-skip safe disposition. Raw also discovered and disposed of its sendSql execution rather than dropping it.

remainingLimits: This calibration establishes the defined source-only workflow on one compact calibration fixture; it does not establish general review effectiveness or a scored-arm result.
The fixture proves construction-level injection. It does not specify database driver support for stacked statements, so that narrower impact detail is not inferred.
Metrics and outcomes from v1 remain preparation evidence only and are not pooled with fresh calibration or future scored runs.
freezeReadiness: The fresh calibration pair satisfies the amended behavioral gate and the independently reviewed dangerous mechanisms/impacts. Scored freeze may proceed if the parent records the required integrity freeze before participants begin.
